scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.build:production: pnpm -r --filter "./lib/**" run build && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.start:production: pnpm run build:production && pm2 start ecosystem.config.js --env production && pm2 save
scripts.stop:pm2: pm2 stop all && pm2 delete all
scripts.production:setup: pnpm install --prod=false && pnpm run build:libs && pnpm run build:production
scripts.clean:all: find . -type d -name 'node_modules' -not -path './node_modules/*' -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null; true && find . -type d -name 'dist' -not -path './node_modules/*' -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null; true
